newsitem.title: UK: Centrica wins first UK electricity supply contract.
newsitem.headline: Centrica wins first UK electricity supply contract.

text.p: British Gas Trading (BGT), part of Centrica plc has won its first contract to supply electricity in Britain's industrial and commercial market, the company announced on Friday.
BGT has started supplying electricity to Hydrocarbon Resources Ltd (HRL), which operates the North and South Morecambe gas fields.
The contract, which was won with a sealed bid, will run for one year, supplying electricity to HRL's three on-shore sites in the 100 kiloWatt market, BGT said.
BGT has been supplying electricity to more than 30 of its own sites for up to a year, Director of Sales Colin MacMillan said.
The company has already said it will sell electricity to domestic consumers when the supply market opens in stages from April next year.
